rules.name: Well-Trained Soldiers
rules.description: All Colonial Marine and Weyland-Yutani Type models gain Stay Frosty and Guardmen.

rules.name: Resourceful
rules.description: A USCM army gains RES(+1). If all Troop squads are destroyed, it loses this ability.

rules.name: UA 571-C Sentry Guns
rules.description: Sentry Guns are Permanent Tokens and are deployed using AP(1) by any model in the squad that purchased them, unless specified otherwise. They activate with AP(1) that may only be used for a Shooting action. They have an RS(10), enter Sentry during the Control Phase, and must always choose the closest unengaged enemy model as a primary target.

rules.description: RES(2): At the start of the squad’s activation, place a marker on an enemy squad within 18” and LOS. Any friendly model targeting the enemy squad may make a Battle Focus action for AP(0).

rules.name: Weyland-Yutani Exosuits
rules.description: Immune to Poison, Gas, and Acid Blood. Acid Spit attacks are reduced by ST(-2).

rules.name: Paired Weapons(H/R)
rules.description: Paired Weapons (X) - The model can use up to two of its equipped weapons of the (X) type in the same action. In ranged combat, both weapons have the same primary target. (X) can be a specific weapon, e.g. (combat knife), or a weapon type, e.g. (HG) or (CC).

rules.name: Paired Weapons(HG)
rules.description: Paired Weapons (X) - The model can use up to two of its equipped weapons of the (X) type in the same action. In ranged combat, both weapons have the same primary target. (X) can be a specific weapon, e.g. (combat knife), or a weapon type, e.g. (HG) or (CC).

rules.name: I Love The Corps!
rules.description: All Colonial Marine Type squads within 12” gain Disposable.

rules.name: Every Formation A Parade
rules.description: If attached to a Colonial Marine Type squad, the squad gains SP(+1) and Fearless (2).

rules.name: Corporate Authority
rules.description: All Weyland-Yutani Type squads gain Disposable.

rules.name: APC Transport
rules.description: May transport multiple squads. May transport a single M577 APC. This counts as 50 slots of its Transport capacity. The APC may also carry squads while embarked on the Dropship.

rules.name: Fireball of Doom
rules.description: If the model is destroyed, scatter two LE templates 20/4” centered from the model’s location. Any models within the template receive a ST(13) autohit as wreckage rains down on them.

rules.name: Targeting System
rules.description: When making a Battle Focus action, gain the bonus to all attack rolls of one Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Motion Tracker
sharedRules.description: While a squad contains a model equipped with a Motion Tracker, all models in that squad gain Eagle Eye (+2). They also gain Target Identifier (5) when testing to spot Stalking squads.
